products.name: Blue Prism
products.note: Enterprise RPA; digital workforce; centralized control; UK-hosted; GDPR relevant

profile_text.body:
SS&C Blue Prism is an automation company, backed by SS&C Technologies, that describes itself as a leader in agentic AI, robotic process automation, and business process management. The company positions its technology as having evolved beyond traditional RPA and intelligent automation toward what it calls agentic process automation, intended to support autonomous work at enterprise scale. Its platform is aimed at large, complex organizations operating in regulated environments.

The company's central product is the SS&C Blue Prism WorkHQ platform, described as an agentic automation platform that unifies human, digital, and AI-driven work in a single control hub. WorkHQ operates alongside SS&C Blue Prism Chorus for enterprise-wide AI orchestration and the SS&C AI Gateway, which the company describes as a governance-first framework providing audit trails, guardrails, role-based access control, and real-time risk notifications for scaling AI agents safely. The site states that agentic automation results are tested and proven through an internal SS&C Innovation Lab. The held facts list Blue Prism as an enterprise RPA and digital workforce product with centralized control, UK-hosted infrastructure, and GDPR relevance.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations appear in the available data for this company.
